name: Impact proportion (asset-level qualification for fund 70% threshold)

regulatory_anchors.regulation: FCA Policy Statement PS23/16: Sustainability Disclosure Requirements (SDR) and investment labels
regulatory_anchors.article: Chapter 4: Sustainability labels (paragraphs 4.32-4.38 — minimum 70% of fund assets must deliver impact for the Sustainability Impact label)

summary: PS23/16 requires ≥70% of fund assets to deliver the stated positive impact for the Sustainability Impact label. At the project (asset) level, this criterion tests whether the asset would qualify toward the fund's 70% numerator. Asset-level qualification cascades from the upstream Impact criteria (c10 objective, c11 measurement, c12 additionality) — all three must be aligned for the asset to count; any not_aligned upstream caps this criterion at not_aligned. Fund-level 70% aggregation is the FMP's job; PB certifies the asset's eligibility status.
